verifier.name: veraPDF
verifier.limitation: veraPDF evaluates machine-verifiable requirements only; a passing report cannot replace human inspection of semantics and reading order.

render.note: The accessibility profile replaces orange-book's boxed contents with native structure, supplies natural-language alternatives for every equation, and uses deterministic SVG derivatives for evaluated Mermaid and Graphviz sources whose native Quarto conversion loses fig-alt.

automated_validation.summary: veraPDF 1.30.2 reports the PDF/UA-1 candidate compliant with all 106 evaluated rules and 239,975 checks.

ordinary_pdf_observation.summary: Tagged output is not PDF/UA-1: veraPDF reports missing PDF/UA identification, DisplayDocTitle, a figure alternative, and alternatives or replacement text for formulas.

render.note: This candidate uses plain code to avoid the current fancyvrb/tagpdf stack imbalance, three LaTeX passes to stabilize the ParentTree, and explicitly locked Libertinus Sans text in generated circuit SVGs.

automated_validation.interoperability_observation: Poppler's structure-text parser reports TextPosition, TextAlign, and ListNumbering attribute warnings that require viewer and assistive-technology review.
automated_validation.summary: veraPDF 1.30.2 reports the PDF/UA-2 candidate compliant with all 1,727 evaluated rules and 217,333 checks; its parser also logs 25 duplicated Group-key warnings that remain recorded for follow-up.

ordinary_pdf_observation.summary: The ordinary LuaLaTeX PDF is not PDF/UA-2: it lacks tagged structure, a structure tree, required metadata, and DisplayDocTitle, and it contains untagged non-artifact content.

claim.summary: Both experimental backend candidates now pass their selected veraPDF profiles, but neither may carry a conformance claim until a complete human assistive-technology and structural review is recorded.
